postal_system.normalization_rule: Accept exactly four ASCII digits, preserve leading zeroes and reject prefixes, spaces and separators. Structural validity never proves a current allocation.
postal_system.assignment_rule: A pinned official operator row may establish a locality-to-delivery-office assignment at its capture time. A locality, office, municipality, branch or facility point alone does not establish a complete current allocation denominator or postal perimeter.
postal_system.exception_rule: PO boxes, poste restante, organizations, route-like delivery, facility-only and other special or non-geographic endpoints remain explicit and non-areal unless an authoritative source supplies truthful geometry.
postal_system.geometry_rule: The public operator table supplies locality membership and its locator supplies facility points, not postcode areas. Localities, delivery offices, facility points, municipalities, branches, address or cadastral units, buffers, hulls, Voronoi or raster cells and interpolation never become official postcode geometry.
postal_system.rights_rule: Pin provider, edition or retrieval time, dataset-specific terms, attribution, schema, CRS, byte length, digest and transformation for every artifact. Public viewing, a privacy notice, general open-data policy or statutory access does not imply bulk extraction, derivative or redistribution rights.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Exclude recipient, customer, resident, occupant, owner, rightsholder, personal identifier, title, encumbrance, value, tax, contact and shipment data.
postal_system.territory_rule: Keep North Macedonia identity and scope independent; postal, administrative, statistical, address and cadastral coverage do not alter source identity or determine sovereignty.

quality_gates.pass: Every artifact has provider, edition or retrieval time, dataset-specific terms, attribution, schema, CRS, byte length, digest and reproducible transformation.

Localities, delivery offices, PO boxes, poste restante, organizations and every special or non-geographic class reconcile against a complete current denominator; syntax, locality rows and facility listings do not auto-create allocation.
Every feature is non-area, official area or derived area; locality membership, office/facility points and administrative context stay non-area.
Postal assignment, locality, delivery office, facility, municipality/branch, address, building/parcel context and AGID containment remain separate.
Synthetic fixtures validate behavior but never satisfy production gates.

stages.definition: Sources, assignment classes, rights and blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.

A current complete rights-cleared Pošta na Severna Makedonija four-digit postcode assignment and exception denominator, including localities, delivery offices, PO boxes, poste restante, organizations and other special or non-geographic endpoints, and real postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon surfaces are pinned by edition or retrieval basis, effective date, terms, byte length, SHA-256, coverage and exceptions, published as an approved immutable artifact, and loaded through the real MK API/app so a normalized NNNN search fits and renders a translucent area with a clear outline, selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual classification, source, reference date and confidence. Locality rows, delivery offices, facility points, municipalities, branches, address or cadastral units, buffers, hulls, Voronoi or raster cells and synthetic fixtures never satisfy M2 by themselves. A derived surface is eligible only from an expressly authorized complete current postal-membership denominator with reproducible lineage, limitations and noncanonical status preserved.
Assignment, geometry, rights, privacy and independent holdout gates pass.
Two source refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
